assumptions: 8 deterministic seeds per scenario; 14 days, two logins 12 hours apart, up to 40 casts each
both policies use 0.16 NPC stage scaling; same level-1 recovery in first-island scenarios; late scenarios start with max buildings and gear and the final sea
immediate claim of available daily, weekly and updated voyage rewards; no chapter/collection/captain claims, no ads/payment or cooperative reward
one safe NPC raid attempt, then retreat; shell cells opened sequentially; no hidden-board knowledge

updated uses region ability whenever ready; aquarium construction and care with an 80-supplies/30-food reserve, plus appearances and weekly island festivals only in late scenario with a 5000-coin reserve
this checks bounded progress, reward budgets and accumulation; it is not a retention or final economy measurement
